<thought>To complete the retrosynthesis I need a template for forming an amide from an aromatic carboxylic acid (4‑aminocinnamic acid) and a primary aromatic amine (p‑phenylenediamine). I will search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks an aromatic carboxylic acid and a primary amine and forms an amide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",

  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
